7.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
7.description: Holy Harmony - New RE. Your Renew also increases the healing your target receives from your Priest direct healing spells by 2/3/4%.

7.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
7.description: Killer Instincts - Now increases your melee and ranged critical strike chance by 1/1% and increases the damage of your Counterattack by 4/5%.

7.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
7.description: Savage Defense - Now increases the effect of your Savage Defense by 5/6%, from 4/5%.

7.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)

7.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
7.description: Improved Mind Blast -  Reworked. Now increases the damage of your Mind Blast by 4/5%.

7.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
7.description: Debilitating Roar - Reworked; Now reduces the cooldown of your Challenging Roar by 18/18/20 sec, increases its duration by 1/1/1 sec, and also causes targets affected to have their Physical damage reduced by 2/2/3%.

7.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
7.description: Blessing of the Divines - No longer can trigger Guardian Spirit, has a new visual for its damage reduction effect and should no longer trigger from non-healing spells.

7.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
7.description: Healing Shield - New RE. Your Power Word: Shield now heals the target for 2/3/4% of the damage it absorbs.

7.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)

7.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)

7.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
7.description: Elune????s Blessing - New RE. Your Rejuvenation, Regrowth, Wild Growth, and Riptide spells now apply Elune????s Blessing to their target. This effect increases the critical strike chance of your direct healing Nature spells on the target by 1/2% per RE.

7.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
